text: Weighed by meta-office-20261123-4 against meta_agent/CLAUDE.md, plan.md and template v37. (2) landed as template v38 in 80d0198; (1), (3) and (4) are declined, each covered by a mechanism already in place. (2): README.md is named after the agent and says whom it is for (the person whose work is the request's science task, on its tool and the tool's kind, and the request it was built for) and what it is not for (another tool; work beyond the science task; what CLAUDE.md says the agent does not do; each item CAPABILITIES.json holds, with its reason). The build renders both (bundle.for_whom_section and not_for_section; TEMPLATE.json readme_placeholders) and refuses a README placeholder it cannot fill. It is shown on a plane-wave DFT engine and an optical spectrometer in test_template_v38: 7 OK, and 5 of 7 fail with v37's tree. Declined half of (2): naming the tool to use instead. Which tool a lab uses is the lab's (MP12: the registry is a list, not a ranking), a recommendation needs evidence and the person's word (MP11), and the goal card has no field for it. A field would be the design role's schema change, and nothing asks for one. (1) is covered. A method chosen before a run is a parameter row: its recommendation.mode (lookup among the modes) cites its source and chosen_by says who chose, and it stays inferred until the person confirms (plan.md 14-26, estimate-parameter-ranges). A choice a run calls for while it runs goes in v12's Decisions section, whose every line names the diagnostic skill, the tool output it judges and the row that hands each criterion. A request that needs a method chosen at run time names such a decision with a library skill whose manifest cites its source. A table of which method fits which case, written into the section's text, would be a criterion the builder holds in text, which the section forbids ('never on a criterion of your own'), and a ranking MP12 forbids. (3) is covered. contracts/schemas/error_contract.schema.json requires remediation.action on every error contract, the template's CLAUDE.md names remediation as a field of every error, and the built bundles carry one per contract, for example hoomd-h2-bond's 'give a box side longer than the rest length'. Writing a remediation per failure is the work of design-tool-interface at S4, not of a template. (4) is covered. Since v3 a bundle's long reference is split into .claude/skills/run-skill/library/, one page per library skill rendered from its manifest and read when needed, beside session skills loaded at the work they name. Source documents are not carried into a bundle. What binds a session stays in its CLAUDE.md (the person, 2026-11-12), so rules are not split out. Not taken, as the ask says: values with no source, unpinned installs and unchecked examples. No text of that collection was copied.
